transport.authorization: Existing owner-host Bearer registry credential; plan for writes, status for reads; exact registered project scope. Never given to an engine.

canonical_revision_digest.serialization: company.contracts.canonical: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false

runtime_invariants: Only trusted owner-host calls are supported. Authenticate current registry/principal and exact registered project, including inside the lease/transaction before mutations and replay. No employee/engine owner-bearer fallback or body-supplied authenticated identity.

Owner mandate, intake and review originate in authenticated owner UI flows. Forwarded model JSON cannot invoke or establish owner intent. Proposal origin is always owner_forwarded_unverified_local_draft; client permit, policy, source UUIDs, timestamps and digest remain unverified claims. Do not dereference them or attest employee, machine, model or native admission.

Every ref scope equals the request project. Resolve type/id/revision/digest only within that project; check all supplied refs and LocalDraft.projectId. Proposal LocalDraft.requestId must equal the client request identity recorded with its referenced intake; the original intake instruction stays separate from the proposal interpretation.

Intake references the exact current mandate. Proposal references the exact current intake and mandate, and the intake must reference that same mandate. Review references exact current proposal plus its same current intake/mandate; stale controlling versions reject stale_basis. Never silently merge or rebase.

One mandate head exists per project. Null expected_head_digest creates it; a digest CAS replaces that exact head. Intake/proposal null ID plus null head creates a server ID; a nonnull server ID plus digest CAS appends a revision. References and predecessor digests identify immutable history.

Review decision history is separate from proposal content. expected_review_digest must match the latest review for that exact proposal revision, or null for its first decision. Positive reviewed is planning-only. It cannot create a WorkOrder, task, attempt, reservation, owner operational approval or publication.

Reuse durable owner-message deduplication: authenticated principal plus message_id binds action and all canonical arguments, across project and legacy owner commands. Recheck current auth/project first, then return the same immutable receipt on exact replay before head CAS. Changed arguments return message_conflict. Do not return a prior receipt to a different principal.

Only a server storage receipt confirms a commit. Any error, timeout or missing response leaves commit unconfirmed; retain the same message_id and exact arguments for recovery rather than automatically making a new mutation ID. Receipts are historical commit evidence, not current-head or execution evidence.

Each mandate and intake snapshot and LocalDraft.content is at most65536 UTF-8 bytes. Entire new-route requests/responses are at most131072 bytes. Apply new limits only to these five paths; existing legacy framing stays32768. Reject oversized required data instead of truncating original owner text or proposal content.

Proposal task IDs are unique, dependencies name existing tasks and are acyclic, dependency/source arrays contain no duplicates, and each task.sourceRefs entry belongs to LocalDraft.sourceRefs. ProposedEmployeeId is only a suggestion from E02 through E32 or null. Source UUIDs are not server evidence receipts.

Canonical server revision digests hash exactly {type,id,scope,revision,previous_digest,body}; use server-assigned IDs/revisions and preserve original string values. Do not substitute or compare Gen local JSON.stringify envelope digests as server identity.

planning-context returns only one immutable body: null record_ref selects current mandate; explicit refs select one exact version. Absent current mandate yields not_recorded/null. A missing explicit ref is404; a mismatched supplied digest is409 reference_mismatch. Current head, currentness and linked/latest-review metadata never substitute another body or disclose out-of-scope data.

A RecordView current_head_ref has the same type, id and scope as its record. linked_refs and latest_review are checked in that project and refer to the exact selected body/revision. Latest review metadata never implies independent technical review or company acceptance. Do not expose storage keys, absolute host paths, raw registry/token values or global counts.

All writes append planning records and immutable receipts in the existing Store transaction only. Reads create no records. No company-wide/unregistered-project/policy changes, history listing, task graph admission, engine tool expansion or native capability is implemented by this candidate.

Proposal view state is submitted only when no stored review exists; otherwise it equals that exact latest stored decision. Other record views use state recorded and no latest_review metadata. A projected state never fabricates an owner decision.
